changes_from_v1: compact-table cell grammar rewritten to an exactly reversible shape-tagged scheme (coordinator gap 2 / review F5): v1 encoded non-present markers as bare '!kind' strings, which collided with present source strings such as '!missing', and frame tags as {f, v}, which collided with present objects of that exact shape; v2 makes the wire shapes explicit and escapes colliding data, so every present value round-trips

typed/model-visible separation (coordinator gap 4 / review F1): verbatim source archive lives in archive.* field families of the canonical records; model_visible_typed_view strips them and applies the cutoff/availability policy independently

lossless_definition.equality: decode(encode(x)) == x exactly; ints/strings/bools by value, floats as binary64 values parsed from source JSON text; no epsilon
lossless_definition.tolerance_source: the original data's own JSON decimal precision; no arbitrary tolerance is introduced at any stage
lossless_definition.float_rule: repr-roundtrip binary64; NaN/Inf rejected upstream by the schema

order_semantics.field_keys: sorted at encode; key order carries no semantics
order_semantics.record_order: normalized away; semantic_equivalent() compares sorted canonical JSON multisets
order_semantics.list_order: preserved and semantically significant: vector axis order (E,N,U / N,E,D), field_names/cells pairing, bindings object key order is normalized but bindings are name-keyed

compact_table.column_presence: an absent record key is a null cell; a key literally present with None is the explicit non-present marker {"np": <column>}; decode restores presence exactly
compact_table.record_metadata: provenance and source_family columns (native-review D1) carry complete record metadata through the roundtrip, so transported_q / archive_only exclusion stays enforceable after any compact decode; canonicalize() preserves this semantic metadata (native third replay), so canonicalize->compact keeps the availability gates effective
compact_table.pool_interning: repeated strings/structures (source dicts, field-name lists, entity ids, episode id) are interned per table into 'pool'; rows store indices; lossless by index resolution

cell_encodings.non_present_kind: explicit object {"np": kind} for kinds present/mapping-check in VALUE_KINDS; unknown kinds raise
cell_encodings.escaped_data: any data object whose key set would collide with a reserved wire shape ({np}, {d}, {f, v}) is stored as {"d": data} and unwrapped on decode; no legal payload is ever rejected
cell_encodings.literal_passthrough: everything else, including '!'-prefixed present strings, is stored and decoded verbatim

typed_views.to_typed_input: entities/states/edges/events dictionaries built from the same canonical records; used for graph/typed consumers
typed_views.model_visible_typed_view: record-level availability/cutoff policy plus field-level strip of all families outside TYPED_VIEW_FAMILY_PREFIXES; verbatim archive.*, full future scripts/names, terminal and hindsight-only content never reach this view

measurement_policy.bytes: always reported from len(utf-8 encoded text)
measurement_policy.tokens: only from the authorized local Qwen tokenizer (CPU, no weight load); if the tokenizer is not loaded, byte counts are reported and never presented as token counts
